title: A ring-like concentration of mm-sized particles in Sz 91
question: What is the radial distribution of mm-sized dust grains versus 12CO gas in the transition disc Sz 91, and is it consistent with planet-disc interaction models?

data.angular_resolution: Continuum beam 0.21x0.15 arcsec (42x30 au), PA 79.9 deg; 12CO beam 0.60x0.57 arcsec
data.sensitivity: continuum median rms 0.95 mJy/beam; 12CO line-free rms 20.12 mJy/beam

what.value: Dust mass–flux relation calibrated from literature

evidence.quote: linear relations derived by (cite: 2005ApJ...631.1134A; 2007ApJ...671.1800A) and calibrated by (cite: 2008ApJ...686L.115C)

recipe.goal: Process visibilities and image continuum and 12CO
recipe.method: CASA calibration/imaging, continuum subtraction, CLEAN with natural (continuum) and Briggs (CO) weighting, one round self-cal

recipe.goal: Fit ring geometry to continuum visibilities
recipe.method: Fit ring profile to visibilities with uvfit
Linear flux-mass relation at 0.86 mm with d=200 pc, 10% flux and distance uncertainties
assumptions: ISM grain size distribution with power-law index p = -3.5; optically thin emission; d = 200 pc

recipe.method: Moment-0 and Moment-1 from >3 sigma channels, pixels below 2.5x median rms excluded, Gaussian fitted along spectral axis

recipe.goal: Fit radial surface brightness profile of the ring
recipe.method: Fit Gaussian, hat-like and r^-1 power-law profiles along the major axis, convolved with 0.16 arcsec FWHM Gaussian; MCMC
key_parameters: Beam FWHM 0.16 arcsec along major axis

evidence.quote: we derive a total mass of $23\pm6\,M_\mathrm{Earth}$
its integrated flux is $4.932\pm0.023$ Jy $\mbox{${\rm km\,s}^{-1}$}$

evidence.loc: Surface brightness profile of mm emission
evidence.quote: a Gaussian profile centred at $110.5\pm0.3$ au and with $1\sigma$ width of $22.2\pm0.5$ au
